description: Feasibility Study and Assessment of Communications Approaches for Real-Time Traffic Signal Applications Study [supporting datasets] is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office, Leidos (United States). This dataset contains Signal Phasing and Timing (SPaT), MAP, and Basic Safety Messages (BSM) data from the "Feasibility Study and Assessment of Communications Approaches for Real-Time Traffic Signal Applications" project in the hexadecimal string and pcap formats. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-PDDC. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
